headline: Weathered Expanse Erupts as Clashes Shake Central Frontlines
war_summary: Since the previous edition, tactical movement has intensified sharply in Weathered Expanse, where five base transfers occurred over the past two hours around Spirit Watch amidst heavy fighting and more than thirteen hundred combined casualties. Stlican Shelf remains a focal point of intense contest, logging four base exchanges in the last two hours across The Pale House and neighbouring sectors. Elsewhere along the front, Dead Lands, Stonecradle, and Godcrofts each recorded two base events over the two-hour window, with Dead Lands absorbing over fifteen hundred casualties as engagement rates accelerate. In contrast, action in Callahan's Passage has slowed markedly, yielding zero base shifts and a steep drop in casualty rates following earlier contention over The Latch. High-intensity attrition continues in Linn of Mercy, where casualties are accelerating on both sides despite strategic base ownership holding firm through the latest reporting period.
